base, num = map(int, input().split())
valid = True
digits = []

while num != 0:
    digits.insert(0, num % base)
    num //= base

for i in range(len(digits)):
    d = digits[i]
    if d == 0 or d == 1:
        continue
    if d == base - 1:
        j = i + 1
        while j < len(digits):
            val = digits[j]
            if val == base - 1:
                digits[j] = 0
            else:
                digits[j] = val + 1
                break
            j += 1
    else:
        valid = False
        break

print("YES" if valid else "NO")
